$note: EXAM CONFIG (no coding needed). This file registers the recruitment papers that get their own SEO landing page (exam-<id>.html). Each entry needs: id (url slug), name (used in the H1, title and breadcrumb), summary (1-2 sentences describing the paper - keep it factual, never dates/marks/eligibility), subjects (subject ids from subjects.json this paper leans on - drives Exam -> Subject links), categories (optional category folder ids, e.g. 'punjab-gk' - drives Exam -> Topic links through that category). Topic links are derived automatically from subjects/categories, so you never list topics by hand. To publish a NEW exam: add an entry here, run python3 scripts/build_landing_pages.py, then python3 scripts/seo_check.py. The generator also refreshes SEO-LANDING-REPORT.md and the sitemap entries.

exams.name: Punjab Police Constable
exams.summary: The highest-volume recruitment on this list. Build your base with Punjab GK and current affairs, then drill reasoning until speed is automatic.

exams.name: Punjab Police ASI
exams.summary: Assistant Sub-Inspector papers separate candidates on English and Punjabi accuracy as much as on general awareness. Practise language daily.

exams.name: Punjab Police Sub-Inspector (SI)
exams.summary: The most competitive paper here. Polity, history and quant reasoning decide the rank - so take full timed mocks before the exam.

exams.name: Punjab Police Intelligence Assistant
exams.summary: Data handling, mental ability and computer awareness carry most of the weight. Use short topic sets and check every explanation.

exams.name: Punjab Police Jail Warder
exams.summary: A tighter syllabus: general awareness, Punjabi and basic reasoning. Perfect for a daily quiz habit - short sessions, high consistency.

exams.name: Patwari
exams.summary: Revenue work starts with Punjab geography, history and current affairs. Add quant for the sections that reward calculation speed.

exams.name: Excise Inspector
exams.summary: General awareness and English carry this paper. Track Punjab policy news daily and revise it as MCQs, not as notes.

exams.name: Forest Guard
exams.summary: Environment, geography and general science, with a physical test after the written paper. Keep science revision short and frequent.

exams.name: Naib Tehsildar
exams.summary: Land records, Punjab history and polity, plus data interpretation. A strong polity base is the fastest score to build.

exams.name: Senior Assistant
exams.summary: Office procedure, computer applications and both languages. Computer MCQs are the highest-yield block - practise them until they are free marks.

exams.name: Clerk
exams.summary: Grammar, comprehension, typing and basic computer knowledge. Accuracy beats speed here - review every wrong answer.

exams.name: Lab Attendant
exams.summary: A short, high-scoring paper: lab safety, general science and reasoning. Ten focused minutes a day is usually enough to cover it.

exams.name: PPSC posts
exams.summary: Punjab Public Service Commission papers are syllabus-heavy and spread over months. Follow a study plan and revise on a fixed cycle.

exams.name: PSPCL jobs
exams.summary: Recruitment by the Punjab State Power Corporation Limited. Technical aptitude sits alongside general awareness and reasoning.
